descriptionChirho: To read out or read aloud, especially a written document (Aramaic Pe'al and Pe'il); used of reading the handwriting on the wall (Dan 5) and official letters (Ezr 4:18,23).
To call out or proclaim loudly (Aramaic Pe'al participle); used of heralds making public announcements (Dan 3:4, 4:11, 5:7).
To be summoned or called (Aramaic Hithpe'el); passive reflexive sense of being called forth (Dan 5:12).
